name: io.github.boostuagency/combell-mcp-boostu
description: MCP server for the Combell hosting API. Manage domains, DNS, hosting, mail and databases in Claude and other AI assistants.

environmentVariables.name: COMBELL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Combell API key (My Combell > API)

environmentVariables.name: COMBELL_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Your Combell API secret (My Combell > API)

environmentVariables.name: COMBELL_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable (default: all groups)
